paragraphs: Titan America SA was incorporated in Belgium on July 17, 2024 and is a limited liability company (société anonyme/naamloze vennootschap) under Belgian law. We are registered with the Register of Legal Entities (registre des personnes morales/rechtspersonenregister) of Brussels (French-speaking division) and are registered with the Crossroads Bank for Enterprises (Banque-Carrefour des Entreprises/Kruispuntbank van Ondernemingen) under number 1011.751.174.

We are majority owned by Titan SA, the parent company of the Titan group of companies. Established in 1902 in Greece, Titan SA is a multinational cement and building materials producer with cement production facilities in ten countries, serving customers in more than 25 countries globally. As of the date of this Annual Report, Titan SA beneficially owns approximately 87% of our common shares. We are a "controlled company" under corporate governance standards and to take advantage of certain corporate governance exceptions related thereto.

In 2023, we completed a $73 million investment at our terminal at Port Tampa Bay, Florida (our "Port Tampa Bay Terminal") and our terminal at Norfolk, Virginia (our "Norfolk Terminal"), constructing new domes, adding multi-product storage capacity of approximately 70,000 tons each, as well as on other repairs and refurbishments.

On February 10, 2025, we completed our initial public offering of 24,000,000 common shares (the "IPO"). The IPO was comprised of a primary offering of 9,000,000 newly issued common shares and a secondary offering of 15,000,000 existing common shares. The common shares were sold at an offering price of $16.00 per share, generating proceeds of approximately $136.8 million, after deducting underwriting discounts and other commissions. Our common shares began trading on the New York Stock Exchange on February 7, 2025 under the symbol "TTAM".

On March 11, 2025, the underwriters exercised a portion of their overallotment option and purchased 580,756 additional existing shares from Titan SA (the selling shareholder). The Company did not receive any additional proceeds from the sale of these shares. As of the date of this Annual Report, the Company has a total of 184,362,465 common shares issued and outstanding.

Our registered office is located at Place Sainte-Gudule 14, 1000 Brussels, Belgium and our telephone number is +32 2 726 80 58. Our website is www.titanamerica.com. Our agent for service of process in the United States is John Christy, 5700 Lake Wright Drive, Suite 300, Norfolk, Virginia 23502.

We file reports and other information with the SEC pursuant to the SEC's rules and regulations that apply to foreign private issuers. The SEC maintains a website that contains reports, proxy and information statements, and other information regarding issuers that file electronically with the SEC. Titan America's electronic filings are available for viewing on this website, at https://www.sec.gov.

In the fiscal years ended December 31, 2023, 2024 and 2025, our net capital expenditures were $118.6 million, $137.3 million and $163.3 million, respectively. The funding requirements of such various capital expenditures were financed by cash provided principally by operating and financing activities or the existing balance of cash and cash equivalents.

We prioritize growth and productivity initiatives, and our investments focus on enhancing logistics capabilities, expanding cement and aggregate production, and strengthening our downstream product lines. Simultaneously, we invest in maintenance activities to support cement and quarry production, as well as the enhancement of storage facilities across our network.

Titan America is a leading vertically integrated, multi-regional manufacturer and supplier of heavy building materials and services operating primarily in Florida, the New York and New Jersey Metropolitan area ("Metro New York"), Virginia, North Carolina and South Carolina (Virginia and the Carolinas, together with Metro New York and their adjacent areas, the "Mid-Atlantic"). We are a leading provider of materials that contribute to lower carbon emissions than traditional building materials and/or beneficial
reuse of waste materials. We serve markets that benefit from population growth, economic growth and technology and innovation trends that are among the strongest in the United States.

We operate and maintain two cement plants, three multi-product marine import terminals, seven active mine locations, 82 ready-mix locations with 96 batch plants, eight concrete block locations with 13 production lines, seven fly ash plants and 22 distribution hubs that can handle various combinations of our products.

Due to the regional nature of our business, we report our operating results in two reportable segments: Florida and Mid-Atlantic. We run our operations nimbly allowing us to pivot resources to markets we support with the greatest demand based on market conditions.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry
We have been, and may continue to be, adversely impacted by volatility and seasonality in the U.S. residential and non-residential construction markets.
Fluctuations in energy, fuel prices and transportation costs could have an adverse effect on our costs of goods sold.
Significant changes in prices for or availability of commodities, labor or other production inputs could negatively affect our costs of goods sold.
Increased market demand for cement substitutes could have an adverse impact on our business.
We operate in a highly competitive industry.
A material disruption at one or more of our facilities or in our supply chain could have a material adverse effect on us.
Delays in construction projects and any failure to manage our inventory could have a material adverse effect on us.
Any delay or problem with operating or upgrading our existing information technology infrastructure could cause a disruption in our business and adversely impact our financial results.
Our aggregate resource and reserve calculations are estimates and subject to uncertainty.

We may not be able to secure, permit or economically mine strategically located aggregate reserves or locate, permit or operate new ready-mix concrete sites, concrete block sites or distribution terminals.
We may not be successful in implementing our growth strategy, which could have a material adverse effect on us.
A large proportion of our business, operations and assets are concentrated in parts of the Eastern Seaboard of the United States.
Our financial condition and operations could be adversely impacted by climate change.

Our customer relationships are not generally governed by long-term agreements, and, as a result, such customers have the right to change the terms under which they do business and/or terminate their relationship with us.

Our business is based in part on government-funded infrastructure projects and building activities, and any reductions or reallocation of spending or related subsidies in these areas could have an adverse effect on us.
Our industry is capital intensive, and we have significant fixed and semi-fixed costs; therefore, our profitability is sensitive to changes in volume.
An inability to successfully identify, consummate and integrate acquisitions, divestitures and other significant transactions could have an adverse impact on our business and financial results.

A lowering or withdrawal of the ratings, outlook or watch assigned to our business or our debt by rating agencies or the credit rating of Titan SA may increase our future borrowing costs and reduce our access to capital.

Our ability to repay or refinance our indebtedness on time and distribute dividends and share capital to our shareholders depends upon our future cash flows from operations, as well as prevailing market conditions.
We are exposed to risk of loss resulting from the nonpayment and/or nonperformance by our customers and counterparties.
Fluctuations in foreign exchange rates may have an adverse effect on our business.
We are subject to impairment losses related to non-financial assets.
We may fail to retain and attract qualified and skilled employees, including management, engineering and technical personnel, or fail to maintain satisfactory labor relations with our unions.
Artificial intelligence presents risks and challenges that can impact our business by posing security risks to our confidential information, proprietary information and personal data.
Risks Related to Our Relationship with Titan S.A.
We rely on functions, systems and infrastructure provided by Titan Group, and if Titan Group fails to perform these services we may fail to replicate or replace them.
paragraphs: This section contains forward-looking statements that are subject to the Cautionary Statement Regarding Forward-Looking Information appearing earlier in this Annual Report. Risks to Titan America are also discussed elsewhere in this Annual Report.

Our business is largely dependent on demand for residential construction, public spending levels for infrastructure and large-scale projects. The U.S. residential and non-residential construction markets are volatile and subject to cyclical market pressures. The level of activity in the U.S. residential and non-residential construction markets is based on numerous factors such as availability of credit, interest rates, general economic conditions, consumer confidence and other factors that are beyond our control. As a result of macroeconomic headwinds we have faced over the past several years, such as prolonged inflationary cost pressures, supply chain disruptions, the impact of public health crises and geopolitical conflicts, U.S. residential and non-residential construction markets have been adversely affected, and may continue to be adversely affected in the future, by changes in the cost of raw materials as well as labor costs, energy costs and freight costs associated with transportation of raw materials. In addition, demand for our products could decline if companies and consumers are unable to obtain financing for construction projects or if an economic recession causes delays or cancellations to infrastructure projects. A significant downturn in activity in either the U.S. non-residential or residential construction markets could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial position, results of operations and cash flows.

We cannot predict the market conditions that will impact the residential or non-residential construction industry or the timing of residential or non-residential construction activity. We also cannot provide any assurances that the operational strategies we have implemented to address current market conditions will be successful. Weakness in the non-residential or residential construction industry could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial position, results of operations and cash flows. Due to the potential volatility in the residential and non-residential construction markets, there may be fluctuations in our operating results, and the results for any historical period may not be indicative of results for any future period. Any uncertainty about current economic conditions can pose a risk to our business, financial position, results of operations and cash flows, as participants in the U.S. non-residential and residential construction industries may postpone spending in response to tighter credit, negative financial news or declines in income or asset values, which could have a material negative effect on the demand for our products.

A significant portion of our business is seasonal, with results of operations affected by weather conditions. For the Mid-Atlantic region, construction material production and related contracting services typically follow the activity in the construction industry, with heavier workloads in the spring, summer and fall. Accordingly, we typically experience a decrease in sales in our Mid-Atlantic reportable segment during the first and fourth quarters reflecting the effect of the winter season in North America and an increase in sales in the second and third quarters reflecting the effect of the summer season in North American markets. Besides the seasonal effects of weather conditions, extreme or unusually adverse weather conditions, which have occurred and may reoccur, such as extreme temperatures, heavy or sustained rainfall or snowfall, wildfires, hurricanes and storms may affect the demand for products and the ability to perform services on construction work. Heavy or sustained rainfall may particularly impact operations of our ready-mix concrete business. Extreme or unusually adverse weather conditions could negatively affect our results of operations, financial position and cash flows.

A significant proportion of our cost of goods sold are incurred in connection with the consumption of thermal and electric energy necessary to produce our products, and in connection to transportation costs incurred for the distribution of our products. Cement production consumes a large quantity of energy, especially for the kilning and grinding processes.

paragraphs: The following discussion and analysis of the financial condition and results of operations of Titan America should be read together with our audited consolidated financial statements as of December 31, 2025 and 2024 and for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, together with related notes thereto, included elsewhere in this document. The discussion and analysis should also be read together with the sections entitled "Risk Factors." The following discussion contains forward-looking statements that reflect future plans, estimates, beliefs and expected performance. The forward-looking statements are dependent upon events, risks and uncertainties that may be outside of our control. Our actual results may differ significantly from those projected in the forward-looking statements. Factors that might cause future results to differ materially from those projected in the forward-looking statements include, but are not limited to, those discussed in the sections entitled "Risk Factors" and "Cautionary Statement Regarding Forward-Looking Information" included elsewhere in this document. Certain total amounts may not sum due to rounding.

Our annual consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this document are prepared in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards ("IFRS") as issued by the International Accounting Standards Board ("IASB"). The definition of IFRS also encompasses all valid International Accounting Standards, as well as all interpretations of the International Financial Reporting Interpretations Committee, including those formally issued by the Standing Interpretations Committee. These financial statements have been prepared under the historical cost convention, except for certain financial assets and liabilities (including derivative financial instruments) and defined benefit pension plan assets, which are measured at fair value.

Our consolidated financial statements included elsewhere in this document present the historical results of operations, financial position and cash flows of Titan Atlantic and its consolidated subsidiaries, including Titan America LLC and its subsidiaries, prior to our IPO. Historical earnings per share have been retrospectively presented to reflect the capital structure following the contribution of Titan Cement Atlantic Single Member Industrial and Commercial S.A. ("Titan Atlantic") to Titan America SA. Titan America's STET business is included in the Company's historical operations for the years ended December 31, 2024 and December 31, 2023. The STET segment was divested on January 1, 2025 to Titan Cement Netherlands B.V., a wholly-owned subsidiary of Titan SA. For the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, the STET segment generated external segment revenue of $1.9 million and segment adjusted EBITDA of $(6.1) million. For the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023, the STET segment generated external segment revenue of $2.0 million and segment adjusted EBITDA of $(6.4) million.
All references to "tons" in this Operating and Financial Review and Prospects refer to short-tons, as defined in the relevant context.

paragraphs: Titan America SA 於 2024 年 7 月 17 日在比利時註冊成立，為一有限責任公司 (société anonyme/naamloze vennootschap) 並受比利時法律規範。我們已於布魯塞爾 (法語區) 的法人登記處 (registre des personnes morales/rechtspersonenregister) 登記，並於 Crossroads Bank for Enterprises (Banque-Carrefour des Entreprises/Kruispuntbank van Ondernemingen) 以編號 1011.751.174 登記。
我們由 Titan SA 多數股權持有，Titan SA 為 Titan 集團的母公司。Titan SA 於 1902 年在希臘成立，為一家跨國水泥與建築材料生產商，於十個國家設有水泥生產設施，服務全球超過 25 個國家的客戶。截至本年度報告日，Titan SA 優先持有我們約 87% 的普通股。我們為一 "受控公司"，並符合企業治理標準，以利用相關企業治理例外條款。
2023 年，我們於佛羅裏達州坦帕灣港 (Port Tampa Bay Terminal) 與維吉尼亞州諾福克港 (Norfolk Terminal) 完成一筆 73 百萬美元投資，建設新穹頂、增加約 70,000 噸多產品儲存容量，以及進行其他修繕與翻新工程。
2025 年 2 月 10 日，我們完成 24,000,000 普通股的首次公開發行 (IPO)。此 IPO 包含 9,000,000 新發行普通股的首次發行與 15,000,000 現有普通股的二次發行。普通股以每股 16.00 美元價格發行，扣除經紀折扣及其他佣金後，籌得約 136.8 百萬美元。我們普通股於 2025 年 2 月 7 日在紐約證券交易所開始交易，代碼為 "TTAM"。
2025 年 3 月 11 日，經紀人行使部分認購權，購買 580,756 股現有股份自 Titan SA (出售股東)。本公司未從這些股份的銷售中獲得任何額外資金。截至本年度報告日，本公司已發行並流通的普通股總數為 184,362,465 股。
本公司註冊辦公室位於比利時布魯塞爾 Place Sainte-Gudule 14, 1000，電話號碼為 +32 2 726 80 58。本公司網站為 www.titanamerica.com。本公司於美國的訴訟程序代理人為 John Christy，地址為 5700 Lake Wright Drive, Suite 300, Norfolk, Virginia 23502。
本公司依美國證券交易委員會 (SEC) 的規則與規範，向 SEC 提交報告及其他資訊，適用於外國私人發行人的相關規定。SEC 保有網站，提供發行人電子提交的報告、代理書與資訊說明書及其他資訊。Titan America 的電子檔可於此網站查看，網址為 https://www.sec.gov。
截至 2023 年 12 月 31 日、2024 年 12 月 31 日及 2025 年 12 月 31 日財務年度，本公司淨資本支出分別為 118.6 百萬美元、137.3 百萬美元及 163.3 百萬美元。這些資本支出的資金需求主要由營運及融資活動提供的現金或現金等價物現有餘額資金融通。
我們優先考量成長與生產力的方案，且我們的投資重點在於提升物流能力、擴充水泥與集料生產，以及強化我們的下游產品線。同時，我們投資於維護活動，以支持水泥與採礦生產，以及提升我們網路中的儲存設施。
Titan America 是一家在美國佛羅裏達州、紐約與新澤西州都會區（"Metro New York"）、維吉尼亞州、北卡羅來納州與南卡羅來納州（維吉尼亞州與卡羅來納州，加上 Metro New York 及其鄰近地區，合稱為 "Mid-Atlantic"）等地主要營運的垂直整合、多區域製造與供應重建材與服務的領導廠商。我們是提供較傳統建材與/或有益於減少碳排放材料的領導供應商。
我們服務的市場受益於人口成長、經濟成長與科技與創新趨勢，這些趨勢是美國最強勁的領域之一。
我們經營並維護兩座水泥廠、三個多產品海運進口碼頭、七處活躍礦區、82 處預拌混凝土設施與 96 個 batching 設施、八處混凝土磚廠與 13 個生產線、七座飛灰廠與 22 個可處理我們各種產品組合的配送中心。
由於我們業務的區域性，我們將營運成果分為兩個應報告分部：佛羅裏達州與 Mid-Atlantic。我們運營方式靈活，使我們能根據市場狀況，將資源轉向我們支持且需求最高的市場。

paragraphs: 下列對財務狀況及營運結果之討論與分析，應與我們經審計之合併財務報表，截至2025年12月31日及2024年12月31日，以及2025年、2024年及2023年年度財務報表，連同相關附註，包含於本文件其他處，一併閱讀。此討論與分析亦應與標題為「風險因素」之部分一併閱讀。下列討論包含前瞻性陳述，反映未來計畫、預估、信念及預期表現。前瞻性陳述依賴於事件、風險及不確定性，這些可能在本公司控制範圍之外。本公司實際結果可能與前瞻性陳述中預測者有顯著差異。可能導致未來結果與前瞻性陳述中預測者有重大差異的因素，包括但不限於，於本文件其他處標題為「風險因素」及「關於前瞻性資訊之警示聲明」部分所討論者。某些總金額可能因四捨五入而無法完全相加。
本文件其他處所包含之年度合併財務報表，係依照國際財務報導準則（"IFRS"）編製，該準則由國際會計準則理事會（"IASB"）頒佈。IFRS之定義亦涵蓋所有有效之國際會計準則，以及國際財務報導解釋委員會之所有解釋，包括由常設解釋委員會正式頒佈者。這些財務報表係依照歷史成本慣例編製，除某些金融資產及負債（包括衍生金融工具）及定義受益養老金計畫資產，係以公允價值衡量外。

本公司合併財務報表包含於本文件其他部分，呈現Titan Atlantic及其合併子公司，包括Titan America LLC及其子公司，在我們IPO前的歷史營運成果、財務狀況及現金流。歷史每股盈餘已回溯性呈現，以反映在Titan Cement Atlantic Single Member Industrial and Commercial S.A.（"Titan Atlantic"）貢獻至Titan America SA後的資本結構。Titan America的STET業務已包含於本公司歷史營運成果，為截至2024年12月31日及2023年12月31日的年度。STET應報告分部於2025年1月1日已出售給Titan Cement Netherlands B.V.，為Titan SA的 wholly-owned subsidiary。截至2024年12月31日財務年度，STET應報告分部產生外部應報告分部營業收入為1.9 百萬美元，以及應報告分部調整後EBITDA為(6.1) 百萬美元。截至2023年12月31日財務年度，STET應報告分部產生外部應報告分部營業收入為2.0 百萬美元，以及應報告分部調整後EBITDA為(6.4) 百萬美元。
本文件「營運與財務評述與展望」中所有提及「噸」之參考，均指短噸，如相關情境所定義。

headings: 與本公司業務及產業相關之風險
本公司已歷來且可能持續受到美國住宅及非住宅建設市場波動及季節性之不利影響。
能源、燃料價格及運輸成本之變動可能對本公司之貨品成本產生不利影響。
水泥替代品價格或供應之重大變動可能對本公司之貨品成本產生負面影響。
市場對水泥替代品需求之增加可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
本公司所處產業為高度競爭之產業。
本公司廠區或供應鏈之一或多處發生重大中斷可能對本公司產生重大不利影響。
建設工程進度延誤及未能有效管理本公司存貨可能對本公司產生重大不利影響。
任何延誤或問題導致本公司現有資訊科技基礎建設之營運或升級受阻，可能造成本公司業務中斷，並對財務結果產生不利影響。
本公司整體資源與儲備之計算為估計值，並受不確定性影響。
本公司可能無法取得、取得許可或以經濟方式開採具戰略價值之資源儲備，或無法尋找、取得許可或營運新之預拌混凝土廠、混凝土磚廠或配送終端站。
本公司可能無法成功執行成長策略，此情形可能對本公司產生重大不利影響。
本公司業務、營運及資產有相當大比例集中於美國東部海岸地區。
氣候變遷可能對本公司財務狀況及營運產生不利影響。
本公司客戶關係通常未受長期契約約束，因此客戶有權變更其與本公司交易之條款及/或終止與本公司之關係。
本公司業務部分依賴政府資助之基礎建設工程及建築活動，若這些領域之支出減少或重新分配相關補貼，可能對本公司產生不利影響。
我行業為資本密集型產業，我們擁有相當大的固定及半固定成本；因此，我們的獲利能力會因銷售量的變動而敏感反應。
若無法成功識別、完成及整合收購、資產處置及其他重大交易，可能會對我們的業務及財務結果產生不利影響。
若我們的業務或我們的債務信用評級、展望或觀察狀態被信用評級機構降低或取消，可能會提高我們未來的借款成本，並降低我們取得資本的機會。
我們能否如期償還或重新融資我們的債務，並向股東發放紅利及發行股份，取決於我們未來來自營運活動的現金流，以及市場條件。
我們面臨因客戶及交易對手未付款及/或未履行契約而產生損失的風險。
外匯匯率的波動可能對我們的業務產生不利影響。
我們面臨與非金融資產相關的減損損失風險。
我們可能無法留住及吸引合格且具專業技能的員工，包括管理層、工程及技術人員，或無法維持與我們工會的良好勞動關係。
人工智慧帶來風險與挑戰，可能影響本公司業務，因它對本公司機密資訊、專有資訊及個人資料造成安全風險。
與 Titan S.A. 關係相關的風險
本公司依賴 Titan Group 提供的功能、系統及基礎建設，若 Titan Group 未能履行這些服務，本公司可能無法複製或取代這些服務。
paragraphs: 本節包含展望性陳述，這些陳述受本年度報告中較前出現的「關於展望性資訊的警示聲明」所限制。Titan America 面臨的風險也於本年度報告的其他部分進行討論。

我們的業務在很大程度上取決於住宅建設的需求、基礎設施與大型專案的公共支出水平。美國住宅與非住宅建設市場波動性高，並受到週期性市場壓力的影響。美國住宅與非住宅建設市場的活動程度取決於多種因素，例如信貸的可取得性、利率、總體經濟狀況、消費者信心及其他超出我們控制範圍的因素。由於我們在過去幾年所面對的總體經濟逆風，例如持續的通貨膨脹成本壓力、供應鏈中斷、公共衛生危機的影響以及地緣政治衝突，美國住宅與非住宅建設市場已受到不利影響，未來也可能持續受到不利影響，因原材料成本以及勞動成本、能源成本及與原材料運輸相關的運輸成本的變化。

此外，若企業與消費者無法取得建設專案的融資，或經濟衰退導致基礎設施專案延遲或取消，我們產品的需求可能會下降。美國非住宅或住宅建設市場活動出現顯著下滑，可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果與現金流產生重大不利影響。由於住宅與非住宅建設市場的潛在波動性，我們的營運成果可能會有波動，任何歷史期間的結果可能無法反映未來期間的結果。任何關於當前經濟狀況的不確定性都可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果與現金流產生風險，因為參與美國非住宅與住宅建設產業的參與者可能因信貸緊縮、負面財務新聞或收入或資產價值下降而延後支出，這可能會對我們產品的需求產生重大負面影響。

本公司業務有相當一部分具有季節性，營運成果受天氣條件影響。對於中大西洋地區，建設材料生產及相關承包服務通常與建設業活動同步，春季、夏季及秋季的業務負荷較重。因此，本公司通常在第一及第四季的應報告分部銷售額會減少，反映北美洲冬季天氣的影響，而在第二及第三季銷售額會增加，反映北美洲夏季市場的影響。除了天氣條件的季節性影響外，極端或異常惡劣的天氣條件，如極端溫度、強降雨或持續性降雨、降雪、野火、颶風及風暴等，可能影響產品需求及在建設工程中執行服務的能力。強降雨或持續性降雨可能特別影響本公司預拌混凝土業務的運作。極端或異常惡劣的天氣條件可能對本公司營運成果、財務狀況及現金流產生負面影響。
本公司成本中相當一部分係因應生產產品所需的熱能及電能消耗，以及產品分銷所產生的運輸成本。水泥生產消耗大量能源，尤其在窯爐及磨碎過程中更為顯著。
